Hi Sophie — thanks for sending. Quick acknowledgement and a short checklist from our side to make the intake efficient: 

1) Party roster: can you confirm which of the three entities on Exhibit A will be the contracting counterparty (legal name + EIN) and who will be the signer?
2) Signer matrix: who needs to sign (counterparty + Nova internal approvers)? If we need multiple signers we typically map authority tiers up front.
3) Residency & data flow: please confirm the countries where Nova will send/receive data related to this integration. If any EU/APAC residency is required, flag that now.
4) Implementation timeline & trial usage estimates (tokens / seats) — helps us size any Dedicated capacity asks.
5) Evidence: if you have a SOC 2 report or privacy questionnaire, attach it; otherwise tell us where to pull it from.

Marissa — can you do a 1-2 paragraph note on top-line redline priorities (liability cap, indemnity carve-outs, residency/data clauses) after you review the attached? Rishi / Kim — FYI for billing/contact points.

I can take first pass on obvious party/contact cleanups and forward the materials to your legal once we align on the contracting counterparty.

Deliverable cadence suggestion: Redwood does a prioritized redline list (not full markup) within 3 biz days after we have the party roster and signer matrix. If you need a full tracked-change draft instead, let us know and we can scope it.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: (we will upload a party-sheet template to share)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Hi all — I reviewed Nova_MSA_Draft_v2.docx and ExhibitA. High-level notes from legal to help you triage internally before we start formal redlines: 

Top-priority items we will likely push back on:
- Liability cap: will request alignment to our standard cap tied to 12 months of fees.
- Data processing/residency: if Nova requires EU-only processing we need to confirm hosting controls and whether Redwood Private or Dedicated is required.
- Indemnity: narrow any customer-side broad infringement indemnities; ask for mutual indemnity where possible.
- SLA/credits: clarify latency / throughput expectations in Exhibit B (order form) before committing to credits.

Evidence/attachments we need from Nova to speed review:
- SOC 2 Type II latest report (or link to the report portal).
- Party verification for all entities on Exhibit A (signed W-9 or equivalent).
- If Nova has a list of sub-processors, include that (helps accelerate privacy review).

Please add the file 'ExhibitA-party-roster.xlsx' with the column 'Legal Entity - Contracting' filled. Once we have that and the SOC2 link, legal can produce a prioritized redline list in 48 business hours. If we see residency constraints we will flag deployment model recommendations (hosted vs dedicated vs private).

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracting Operations
Redwood Inference
